args.code:
# The XOR validation loop:
# edx starts at 0x5b (91)
# For each character:
#   - Read input char c at position i
#   - XOR c with (edx & 0xFF) -> result
#   - Compare result to expected[i]
#   - If match, add c to edx
#
# So: expected[i] = input[i] XOR (edx & 0xFF)
# Therefore: input[i] = expected[i] XOR (edx & 0xFF)

expected = bytes([
    0x1d, 0xed, 0xac, 0x69, 0x0e, 0x9d, 0x38, 0xb0,
    0x5d, 0xf9, 0x68, 0x0b, 0xa5, 0x66, 0xeb, 0x62,
    0x18, 0x96, 0x33, 0xc9, 0x72, 0xb8, 0xf8, 0xcd,
    0x1d, 0x20
])

edx = 0x5b
result = []

for i in range(26):  # 0x1a = 26
    edx_byte = edx & 0xFF
    c = expected[i] ^ edx_byte
    result.append(c)
    edx = (edx + c) & 0xFFFFFFFF  # Keep as 32-bit

flag = bytes(result).decode('latin-1')
print(f"Decoded flag: {flag}")
print(f"Length: {len(flag)}")
print(f"Bytes: {bytes(result)}")
